title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Verify that users can successfully log in with valid username/email and password combinations.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter a valid username/email and corresponding password.
Click the login button.
Confirm that login is successful and the user is redirected to their dashboard.

title: User Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Ensure that login fails with invalid username/email or password and proper error messages are displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter an invalid username/email or incorrect password.
Click the login button.
Verify that an appropriate error message is shown and login is not allowed.

title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully by providing valid data including all mandatory fields.

steps.description: Navigate to the registration page.
Input valid personal details, contact information, and password.
Submit the registration form.
Confirm registration success and system sends verification where applicable.

title: User Registration with Missing Mandatory Fields
description: Ensure the registration form validates mandatory fields and shows appropriate error messages when fields are missing.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page.
Leave mandatory fields blank and attempt to submit the form.
Verify validation errors are displayed for each missing mandatory field preventing submission.

title: Loan Calculator Accuracy for Various Inputs
description: Verify the loan calculator correctly computes repayment amounts, interest, and monthly installments for different amounts, terms, and interest rates.

steps.description: Navigate to the Loan Calculator page.
Input a loan amount, term, and interest rate.
Trigger the calculation.
Verify the repayment schedule and interest amounts are accurate as per calculation formulas.
Repeat with edge values such as minimum and maximum allowed loan amounts and terms.
Confirm calculator handles edge cases without errors and returns usable results.

title: Pre-Qualification Eligibility Check
description: Verify the pre-qualification tool accurately determines eligibility based on credit and employment checks before submission.

steps.description: Navigate to the pre-qualification page.
Input applicant data including employment and credit info.
Submit the pre-qualification check.
Verify the system returns correct eligibility status either 'eligible' or 'not eligible' with reasons.
Test with borderline cases and invalid inputs.
Ensure the tool handles these gracefully and responds accordingly.

title: Multi-Step Loan Application Completion
description: Ensure the multi-step loan application form collects and validates borrower personal, employment, and document details correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to the loan application page.
Complete personal details step with valid data.
Check that form proceeds to employment details step.
Complete employment information accurately.
Verify successful navigation to document upload step.
Upload all required documents and submit application.
Confirm application submission success and correct data persistence.

title: Loan Application Form Validation on Missing Fields
description: Verify the loan application form validates mandatory fields at each step and prevents progressing or submitting with missing or invalid data.

steps.description: Navigate to loan application page.
Attempt to proceed from personal details step with missing mandatory fields.
Errors must be shown for each missing field and prevent moving forward.
Repeat validation on employment details and document upload steps.
Confirm consistent validation behavior preventing incomplete submissions.

title: Admin Review Loan Applications with CRB and PMIC Compliance
description: Verify admin can access loan applications, view CRB and PMIC integration results, approve or reject applications accordingly.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to loan applications management.
Select a submitted application.
Verify CRB and PMIC check results are visible and clearly displayed.
Approve the application with valid checks.
Confirm the status of the application updates to approved.
Reject an application failing compliance checks.
Verify status updates to rejected and reason is logged.

title: Loan Disbursement Processing
description: Verify that after admin approval, loans can be disbursed correctly and reflected in borrower dashboards.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to disbursements management.
Select approved loan applications ready for disbursement.
Process disbursement.
Confirm loan status updates to disbursed and borrower wallet balance reflects the disbursed amount.
Login as borrower and verify updated loan and wallet details on dashboard.

title: Repayment Processing and Receipt Generation
description: Validate that repayments can be processed both manually and via bulk processing, with accurate repayment schedules and receipts generated.

steps.description: As admin, navigate to repayments management.
Process a manual repayment for an active loan.
Verify repayment schedule is updated and receipt is generated correctly.
Prepare a bulk repayment batch and submit.
Confirm all repayments in bulk are processed correctly with receipts generated.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify system enforces permissions for all user roles. Differentiate access rights for borrowers, admins, and staff on various modules.

steps.description: Login as borrower and attempt to access admin pages.
Access should be denied with appropriate messages.
Login as staff with limited permissions and attempt actions beyond role.
Verify actions are blocked and unauthorized access is logged.
Login as admin and access restricted sections.
Confirm full access granted as per role.

title: Audit Log Captures Critical User and System Activities
description: Ensure all key system events such as logins, loan approvals, disbursements, repayments, and configuration changes are logged with timestamp, user and details.

steps.description: Perform critical actions like login, approve loan, disburse loan, process repayment, and change settings.
Navigate to audit logs as admin.
Verify logs exist for each action with accurate details and timestamps.

title: Multi-Tenant Data Isolation
description: Confirm that tenant data is completely isolated in the SaaS platform and that cross-tenant data access is blocked.

steps.description: Login as user of tenant A and access tenant data.
Verify no data from tenant B is visible or accessible.
Login as admin of tenant B and verify tenant A data is inaccessible.

title: Notification Delivery via Email and SMS
description: Verify notifications related to loan applications, repayments, and system alerts are sent promptly and accurately via configured email and SMS providers.

steps.description: Trigger notification events such as loan approval and repayment reminders.
Verify notifications are delivered to users via email and SMS.
Test system behavior on notification service failure by simulating errors.
Ensure failures are logged and retries or fallback mechanisms occur.

title: Admin Legal Case Management for Loans
description: Verify admin can create, update, and track loan-related court cases and assign lawyers correctly in the collections management module.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to collections management.
Create a new legal case linked to a loan.
Confirm case creation with correct loan association.
Assign a lawyer to the case.
Verify lawyer assignment is saved and reflected in case status.
Update case status and track progress.
Ensure status updates persist and notifications trigger if applicable.

title: Configurable Loan Products Validation
description: Verify loan product configurations allow setting terms, rates, fees, and eligibility rules and these apply correctly in loan calculations and applications.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to loan products management.
Create or update a loan product with specific terms, rates, fees, and eligibility settings.
Confirm configurations save successfully.
Submit a loan application selecting the configured loan product.
Verify loan calculations, eligibility checks, and terms adhere to configured product rules.

title: User Dashboard Loan Status and Wallet Display
description: Check that borrower dashboard shows real-time loan application status, active loans, wallet balance, payment reminders, and available quick actions.

steps.description: Login as a borrower with active loan applications and wallet balance.
Verify the dashboard accurately reflects current loan status, wallet balance, pending payments, and quick apply options.
Trigger status updates by simulating loan application approval or repayment.
Confirm dashboard updates accordingly and timely.

title: Staff Management Role Assignments and Permissions
description: Verify admin can create staff accounts, assign roles, permissions, and that assigned permissions are enforced throughout the system.

steps.description: As admin, create a new staff user.
Assign a predefined role with limited or full permissions.
Confirm staff record saves with correct roles.
Login as staff and verify access matches assigned permissions.
Ensure staff can access only authorized modules and functionalities.

title: Report Generation and Export
description: Verify reports on loans, repayments, and performance generate correctly with accurate data and can be exported in available formats.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to reports section.
Generate loan performance and repayment reports for given date ranges.
Verify reports display correct aggregated data.
Export reports in supported formats (e.g., PDF, CSV).
Confirm exported files contain accurate data and open without errors.
